name: anim_fin_shark
subject: a big chubby shark made of glossy pink paint with yellow marble streaks, sticking up out of a paint puddle, full and satisfied
desc: The smug shark lets out a huge satisfied burp, then spits out a small purple witch hat with a star, soaked in pink paint, which flops onto the puddle; the shark grins mockingly and licks its lips. Thick paint goo drips.
